Title: Architecture review gate C
Purpose: Perform the final pre-closure architecture review after materialization, hardening, decomposition, and tests have all been addressed.
Deliverables: Updated traceability matrix and residual-risk statement
ValidationCommands: Review final architecture outputs and confirm residual debt is explicit, bounded, and accepted
ReviewQuestions: Is the process module materially safer, more maintainable, and less misleading than before?
Do any critical hidden risks remain?
Is the final QA phase justified, or must another corrective loop happen first?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create another corrective subbundle immediately and rerun gate C before final QA.
